g.text: Raw gradient relative L2 errors · three repeats each · receiver waveforms bitwise equal in all six pairs
Dots: all three paired repeats; labels: maximum over repeats for that parameter. No filtering or gradient smoothing.
These are derivative-agreement checks for the same forward operator, not inversion quality or spatial-convergence tests.
